Thursday Night Gravel Ride

Senoia, GA · Gravel

Thursday Night Gravel Ride is a gravel group ride in Senoia, GA. It rolls every Thursday at 6:00 pm from Senoia Bicycle. Pace: a 19–20 mph, B 16–19, C 13–16.

For visitors

Ride leader is announced before the ride. Evenings get dark early from October; bring lights. Call the shop to confirm: 770-599-0308.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 19–20 mph: fast — for riders who race or train. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @senoiabicycle the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Thursday Night Gravel Ride group ride

A Thursday evening gravel ride out of Senoia, 30 to 40 miles in A, B and C groups. The 6:00 start is at the shop and the 6:30 start is at the Haralson Pavilion.
